request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

response.text: The evidence shows that sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 experienced a complete service outage from 2026-09-02 18:00 to 22:00 (T1, T4). Both sites share fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A (T2, T3), which suffered a critical `LINK_LOS` alarm (ALM-000001) at 18:00 (T4), followed immediately by `SITE_DOWN` alarms. No changes or maintenance were scheduled on these nodes during this window (T7, T8), pointing clearly to a transport failure (fiber cut) on LNK-TUN-01-A that fully resolved at 22:00. No further tool calls are required.
